messages:
leo (DevRel): Heads-up — weekend refapp sprint to finalize OSS infra refapp and a short launch post. Need help with benchmark blurb, webinar pilot, and inbound routing. Kickoff doc: https://docs.google.com/xyz

anna (Marketing): @leo love it. Can we ship a 300-400 word launch post + 1 benchmark chart? I can draft. Need numbers by EOD Fri.

maria (Engineering): running final perf runs now. Will post results (latency p95, tokens/sec) — bench cmd:
```
./scripts/run_bench.sh --profile devrefapp --seq 1024 --runs 5
```
ETA 6h.

sanjay (Product): For webinar, propose 30-min demo + 15-min Q&A. Ask registrants to share primary use case in form (helps inbound routing). I can set up form.

eli (Community): I'll seed community repo with a 1-click deploy guide and a mini tutorial (20-min). Can we prioritize Linux + GCP quickstart?

anna (Marketing): For inbound, we should: 1) create a tagging rule in HubSpot: source=refapp_weekend, interest=oss-refapp; 2) add a follow-up workflow to invite to webinar. @sanjay can you add the form field name so we map?

sanjay (Product): form field = primary_use_case

maria (Engineering): RESULTS: p95=87ms, tokens/sec=1200, mem=8.2GB (quantized). Uploading raw logs to GCS: gs://redwood-bench/refapp/2143658700/results.tar.gz

leo (DevRel): awesome. @anna can you take those numbers and sketch two benchmark callouts: latency-focused + throughput-focused? we also need one "how we measured" note for the post.

anna (Marketing): yes — will draft and post in #marketing-drafts. rough timeline: draft by Sat morning, internal review Sat afternoon, publish Mon.

eli (Community): I'll cut the tutorial into two 10-min vids. Could use a short script — I'll drop in the doc.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: refapp-site -> staging at 2143658800 :white_check_mark:

leo (DevRel): thanks everyone. small ask: please add any screenshots to the kickoff doc, and ping when assets are uploaded. :thumbsup:

anna (Marketing): Will do. posting checklist in the doc now: https://docs.google.com/abc-launch-checklist

maria (Engineering): linked the logs and a minimal `perf.json` with run config.

sanjay (Product): I'll stub the HubSpot workflow today and share the mapping.

leo (DevRel): closing loop — if no blockers by Sat noon we'll proceed. If you hit blockers ping here and DM me.
